opening.argument: The material promotes Bitclub Network mining through advertised daily Bitcoin income and a pathway to begin earning by contacting the person who invited viewers. Entry requires buying a miner and paid membership, while the speaker ties compensation to commissions, binary activity, two people working below the participant, and specified direct-participant and team-volume targets. The presentation also supplies an unofficial monthly profitability range of 5 to 15 percent, giving viewers a concrete earnings expectation even as the speaker says the figure is not official. The structure is therefore a paid mining and recruitment scheme built around promised returns, qualification conditions, and team production. Reports that some miners have problems further show that the promoted production is not assured.
